ruling: The Lean genus is defined by HasGenus D c g := 2g + boundary D c = n + 2, where boundary is the textbook rotation-system face count (three half-edges per endpoint, cycles of the face permutation on 6n half-edges; 2 at n = 0). The endpoint and every proof use boundary; the lane's two-dart model dartBoundary is not used. Condition (1)'s requirement to prove dartBoundary equal to boundary therefore applies only if a proof relies on the dart model. DartBridge is NOT required for the endpoint's fidelity. The rotation-system count remains the accepted definitional bridge, supported by the source-table sanity lemmas and by the recorded agreement of both models on all 995,572 (n <= 5) and 2,269,184 (n = 6) cases.
